checks.source_scope: Exact historical target-file views; not full-source builds

limits: Static default-guard analysis is a bounded heuristic, not complete C++ preprocessor/include-graph or CMake semantic proof.
Complex CMake bracket/multiline forms are conservatively unverified when relevant, rather than given a safe guard.
Opt-in build mode runs candidate build code; this tool is not a general execution security sandbox.
Actual current full CLI build qualification and final whole-suite run belong to parent; this source review alone does not claim them.
nonblocking_followup: Included-header macro definitions and unsupported compiler/language mechanisms need independent semantic/build evidence; do not generalize the recognized-grammar PASS.
